literal: To be captured being difficult, having food provisions, for those inside to defend being easy, of such nature is a fortress.
translation: A true fortress is that which is difficult for enemies to capture, well-stocked with food and resources, and easy for those inside to defend.
modern: பகைவர்களால் கைப்பற்றுவதற்கு அரியதாய், தேவையான உணவுப் பொருட்களைக் கொண்டதாய், உள்ளே இருப்பவர்கள் நின்று போரிடுவதற்கு எளியதாய் இருப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential qualities of an effective fortress. First, it must be structurally secure and strategically situated so that it is extremely difficult for enemies to capture (கொளற்கரிதாய்). Second, it must be self-sufficient and stocked with ample food and provisions (கொண்டகூழ்த்து) to withstand long sieges. Finally, its design must make it easy and advantageous for the defenders inside to hold their ground and fight back (அகத்தார் நிலைக்கு எளிதாம்).
